description: Provider submits a deliverable (POST /api/intents/[id]/deliverables). Requires { content, deliverableHash, actionNonce, signature } from buildDeliverableAction() — the hash signs the content. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: returns the exact body that WOULD be sent. The caller signs the lifecycle action with the SDK's signing helpers; this tool never signs.

dryRun.description: Default true: show, do not send.

name: acm_submit_deliverable
